units.source_text: 寻常人何由见得！”

en.t: How could any ordinary person ever hope to see her!

units.source_text: 他有意刺激匂亲王。

en.t: He said this deliberately to provoke Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“真是个‘喋喋叨叨者’。”

en.t: Prince Niou said, "What a chatterbox."

units.source_text: 他终于生气了。

en.t: At last he grew angry.

units.source_text: 薰君想道：“匂亲王多年来一直和我缠绕不清。

en.t: Kaoru thought, "For years Prince Niou has kept entangling himself with me.

units.source_text: 我因不知道二女公子品貌如何，所以未敢作成。

en.t: Since I did not know what the Second Princess was like in character or appearance, I did not dare arrange it.

units.source_text: 我一直担心：见面后相貌是否丑陋？

en.t: I was always worried: after meeting her, might her looks prove plain?

units.source_text: 接近后性情能否像推想那样优美？

en.t: And once one drew near, would her nature be as lovely as I had imagined?

units.source_text: 昨夜一见，方知一切都无缺陷。

en.t: Only when I saw her last night did I learn that everything about her was flawless.

units.source_text: 大女公子煞费苦心，私下拟定计划，欲荐妹自代，我倘辜负好意，未免太不知情。

en.t: The Elder Princess went to great pains, secretly devised a plan, and tried to recommend her younger sister in her own place; if I were to betray such kindness, I would be far too unfeeling.

units.source_text: 然而要我移爱，实在不能遵命。

en.t: Yet if she asks me to transfer my love, I truly cannot obey.

units.source_text: 我先把二女公子让与匂亲王吧。

en.t: For now I should yield the Second Princess to Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 如此，匂亲王和二女公子两方都不会恨我了。”

en.t: In that way, neither Prince Niou nor the Second Princess will resent me."

units.source_text: 他私下如此摆布，但匂亲王并不得知，一味埋怨他小气，却也可笑。

en.t: He arranged things privately in this way, but Prince Niou knew nothing of it and simply blamed him for being stingy, which was rather amusing.

units.source_text: 薰君对他说道：“你像过去一样轻薄，致使女公子烦恼，实在教人为难。”

en.t: Kaoru said to him, "If you behave as frivolously as before and cause the princess distress, it truly puts me in a difficult position."

units.source_text: 他以女公子父母的身份说这话。

en.t: He said this as though he were the princess's parent.

units.source_text: 匂亲王一本正经地答道：“好，请你看着吧。

en.t: Prince Niou answered with perfect seriousness, "Very well, please watch me.

units.source_text: 我从来不曾像此次这样诚心诚意地恋慕呢。”

en.t: I have never before longed for anyone as sincerely as I do this time."

units.source_text: 薰君说道：“直到现在，两女公子全然不曾表示应允之色。

en.t: Kaoru said, "Up to now, neither of the two princesses has shown the slightest sign of consent.

units.source_text: 你要我玉成，实在是一件苦差事。”

en.t: For you to ask me to bring this about is truly a painful task."

units.source_text: 两人就详细商量访问宇治的办法。

en.t: The two of them then discussed in detail how to visit Uji.
